answer: Sodium hydroxide is in the burette (the tall tube); the flask holds the acid, with a few drops of phenolphthalein added.
Early on, pink flashes where the drops land and then fades as you swirl.
When the pink starts to linger (stops fading), slow down and add drop by drop.
A faint pink that lasts thirty seconds.
Stop adding, then read the volume on the burette (shown as 18.32 mL).
